bodies: British Council, IDP: IELTS Australia and Cambridge University Press and Assessment

exams.name: Kaufman Brief Intelligence Test, Second Edition
exams.blurb: Brief individually administered measure of verbal and nonverbal intelligence often used to screen children for gifted programs.

exams.name: Naglieri Nonverbal Ability Test, Third Edition
exams.blurb: Language-free reasoning test using shapes and patterns, used for gifted screening of students from kindergarten through grade twelve.

exams.name: Otis-Lennon School Ability Test, Eighth Edition
exams.blurb: Group-administered school ability test measuring verbal and nonverbal reasoning, used for gifted admissions in several large districts.

exams.name: Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children, Fifth Edition
exams.blurb: Individually administered IQ test for ages six to sixteen that many private schools and gifted programs accept as cognitive evidence.

exams.name: Wechsler Preschool and Primary Scale of Intelligence, Fourth Edition
exams.blurb: Individually administered intelligence test for children aged two through seven, commonly required for early private school admission.

exams.name: Miller Analogies Test
exams.blurb: Analogy-based graduate admissions test that Pearson officially retired on 15 November 2023; score reports are no longer issued.

exams.name: Pharmacy College Admission Test
exams.blurb: Pharmacy school admissions test retired on 10 January 2024; PharmCAS programs no longer require or accept new PCAT scores.

exams.name: PTE Academic
exams.blurb: Computer-scored English proficiency test lasting about two hours with results usually returned within two days for university admission.

exams.name: Stanford Achievement Test Series, Tenth Edition
exams.blurb: Nationally normed achievement battery used by private schools and homeschool families to document reading, mathematics and content mastery.

exams.name: Character Skills Snapshot
exams.blurb: Online questionnaire that complements the SSAT by reporting a student preferences, attitudes and beliefs to independent school admission teams.

exams.name: SSAT Elementary Level
exams.blurb: Secondary School Admission Test level for students in grades three and four, with no wrong-answer penalty and an unscored writing sample.

exams.name: SSAT Middle Level
exams.blurb: Secondary School Admission Test level for students in grades five through seven, scored 440 to 710 per section with a guessing penalty.

exams.name: SSAT Upper Level
exams.blurb: Secondary School Admission Test level for grades eight through eleven, scored 500 to 800 per section and required by most boarding schools.

exams.name: ISEE Lower Level
exams.blurb: Independent School Entrance Exam level for students in grades four and five, with verbal, quantitative, reading, mathematics and an essay.

exams.name: ISEE Middle Level
exams.blurb: Independent School Entrance Exam level for students in grades six and seven applying to grades seven and eight at independent schools.

exams.name: ISEE Primary Level
exams.blurb: Shortest Independent School Entrance Exam level, given on computer to young applicants in grades two through four with a picture prompt.

exams.name: ISEE Upper Level
exams.blurb: Independent School Entrance Exam level for students in grades eight through eleven, reported in stanines with no penalty for wrong answers.

exams.name: Armed Forces Qualification Test
exams.blurb: Percentile score derived from four ASVAB subtests that determines whether an applicant is eligible to enlist in a US military branch.

exams.name: Armed Services Vocational Aptitude Battery
exams.blurb: Multiple-aptitude enlistment battery used by all US military branches to determine eligibility and qualification for military occupations.

exams.name: ASVAB Career Exploration Program
exams.blurb: School-based version of the ASVAB paired with interest inventories and career planning tools for high school and postsecondary students.

exams.name: Pending Internet Computerized Adaptive Test
exams.blurb: Unproctored at-home version of the ASVAB that must be confirmed by a shortened verification test at a military entrance processing station.

exams.name: Cognitive Abilities Test
exams.blurb: Group-administered reasoning test with verbal, quantitative and nonverbal batteries used widely for gifted and talented program screening.

exams.name: Iowa Assessments
exams.blurb: Nationally normed achievement battery used by homeschool families and private schools and often paired with CogAT for gifted identification.

exams.name: Stanford-Binet Intelligence Scales, Fifth Edition
exams.blurb: Individually administered intelligence test accepted by many gifted programs and high-IQ societies for verifying cognitive ability.

exams.name: Cambridge English B2 First
exams.blurb: Upper-intermediate Cambridge English qualification at CEFR B2 level, accepted by some US institutions as evidence of English proficiency.

exams.name: Cambridge English C1 Advanced
exams.blurb: CEFR C1 Cambridge English qualification tested across reading, writing, listening and speaking and accepted by many US universities.

exams.name: Cambridge English C2 Proficiency
exams.blurb: Highest-level Cambridge English qualification at CEFR C2, demonstrating near-native mastery for academic and professional purposes.

exams.name: Casper Situational Judgment Test
exams.blurb: Open-response situational judgment test required by many medical, dental, nursing and health professions programs in the United States.

exams.name: Duet Values Alignment Assessment
exams.blurb: Short values-alignment assessment in the Altus Suite that compares applicant priorities with the characteristics of a specific program.

exams.name: Dental Admission Test
exams.blurb: Computer-based admissions test for US dental schools covering natural sciences, perceptual ability, reading comprehension and quantitative reasoning.

exams.name: Optometry Admission Test
exams.blurb: Admissions test for US optometry schools covering natural sciences, reading comprehension, physics and quantitative reasoning.

exams.name: Executive Assessment
exams.blurb: Ninety-minute business school admissions test designed for executive MBA candidates, covering integrated, verbal and quantitative reasoning.

exams.name: GMAT Focus Edition
exams.blurb: Current graduate management admissions test with Quantitative, Verbal and Data Insights sections and a total score from 205 to 805.

exams.name: Examination for the Certificate of Proficiency in English
exams.blurb: Advanced English proficiency certificate at CEFR C2 issued by Michigan Language Assessment and used for academic and employment purposes.

exams.name: Michigan English Test
exams.blurb: Modular English proficiency test covering CEFR A2 to C1 that reports listening, reading, speaking and writing scores for study and work.

exams.name: IELTS Academic
exams.body: British Council, IDP: IELTS Australia and Cambridge University Press and Assessment
exams.blurb: Four-skill English test scored 0 to 9 bands and required by many US universities for admission of international applicants.

exams.name: IELTS General Training
exams.body: British Council, IDP: IELTS Australia and Cambridge University Press and Assessment
exams.blurb: Version of IELTS focused on everyday and workplace English, used mainly for migration and vocational programmes rather than degree entry.

exams.name: Cooperative Admissions Examination
exams.blurb: Entrance examination used by Catholic high schools in New Jersey and the Philadelphia area, covering reasoning, language and mathematics.
